option_relations.rationale: Infiltrating lipoma is a benign tumor of mature adipocytes that infiltrates surrounding tissues, but it is not directly related to dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans of the nose.
Spindle cell lipoma is a benign lipomatous tumor characterized by mature adipocytes and spindle cells, but it is not directly related to dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans of the nose.
Liposarcoma is a malignant tumor of adipocytes, which is distinct from dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
Lipofibromatosis is a rare benign tumor of fibrous and adipose tissue, but it is not directly related to dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans of the nose.
